name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Telugu
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-11): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Telugu files have 'Dakshina Dataset' and 'Existing sources' rows, which the filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py drops (the project's licence audit keeps them out of a pack): 60,367 Dakshina and 24,056 Existing rows are dropped by the filter. What is used is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY).
used_for: tel_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/te.neopack. Telugu has manual rows only in tel_test.json, so the romanised Telugu tables (data/langs/te/romanisation.json) are fitted to the mined IndicCorp rows of tel_valid.json (2,878 pairs after the filter), which also validate training. tel_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY) are the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-11. Extract with: unzip tel.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-tel/extracted (data/build-te-text.sh does). tel_train.json has 2,429,562 rows: IndicCorp 2,312,140, Dakshina 50,927, Samanantar 42,413, Existing 24,056, Wikidata 26 (no manual rows). tel_valid.json 7,681: Dakshina 3,716, IndicCorp 3,488, Samanantar 476, Wikidata 1 (no manual rows). tel_test.json 10,260: Dakshina 5,724, AK-Freq 2,241, AK-NEI 1,347, AK-NEF 948. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/te.neopack, a file handed out for a trial, not offered for download, not in the app
